Ready to Eat - Grab a spoon because this is the perfect edible cookie dough. No need to make dough from scratch. Enjoy your edible cookie dough right of the scoop straight from the tub!
Peanut Butter lovers beware.

Our Cookie Doughs are all hand made with only the finest ingredients, including, butter, shortening, fresh eggs, fine chocolates, and delicious nuts. They come shipped in a air tight shipping container, complete with freezer packs, to ensure freshness. We have many flavors, some that you scoop out with a spoon, or roll out for different shapes, or some that you can squeeze out with a pastry bag. You can also include a gift message.
